description: [structures] Upwell structures: the Raitaru, Azbel, Sotiyo and Tatara. Put up by a real EVE client the way a player does: the packaged hull carried in a Charon, deployed through the client's deploy window, anchor and onlining timers run down with the client's own GM structure menu command (/structure timer), docked, the quantum core put in the core room, every service the hull takes fitted and onlined, three rigs, 200,000 fuel blocks. Each must reach full power, take for each service exactly the fuel the client's dogma shows, show a fuel expiry in the structure browser and have stats equal to the type's static data. Lowsec Amamake; parts can run in any order. Needs the client-agent patch.

GM setup: skills, ISK, Amamake; a player corp through the client's corp service
